President Biden and Vice President Harris took on Big Pharma—and won. Their Administration is lowering prescription drug prices by:
1. Capping the cost of insulin at $35 a month for people on Medicare
2. Capping out-of-pocket drug costs for millions of Americans
3. Requiring Big Pharma pays rebates if they raise prices faster than inflation

And now, for the first time ever, our Administration has negotiated lower prices for 10 drugs for Americans with Medicare – with more to come.

President Biden and Vice President Harris will never stop fighting for the health, well-being, and economic security of the American people.

President Biden and his team are closely monitoring the impacts from Hurricane
Ernesto, which passed the U.S. Virgin Islands and Puerto Rico as a tropical storm last night. 
 
Last night,@POTUS approved the Governor of Puerto Rico’s request for an emergency declaration. FEMA has staged resources and personnel in the region and the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Temporary Power Team deployed to Puerto Rico to provide further support as requested.

Residents should remain vigilant and heed the warnings of local officials.
